subject: money a company donated to six charities
overview: Social welfare received by far the most money in every year, while the arts received the least.
Donations to four of the six charities rose over the period; wildlife and the arts rose in 2013 and then fell below their 2012 level.
keyFeatures: Social welfare grew the most in absolute terms, from 40 to 50 ($10,000 more).
Environment grew the most in relative terms, from 15 to 22 (almost +50%).
Wildlife peaked at 12 in 2013, then fell to 9 in 2014.
The arts got the least in every year: 5, 6, then 4.
